The --template and --jq handling that
python/mirage/commands/cli/builtin/gh/constants.py and
typescript/packages/core/src/commands/cli/builtin/gh/constants.ts set up
follows go-gh v2.13.0 (https://github.com/cli/go-gh), the version gh 2.85.0
builds with: TEMPLATE_TOKEN, TEMPLATE_ACTION and TEMPLATE_DECLARATION read a
template's actions as its template package does, and GOJQ_RAISED holds the
errors its jq package reports. In
python/mirage/commands/cli/builtin/gh/accessor.py and
typescript/packages/core/src/commands/cli/builtin/gh/accessor.ts, --jq prints
each result and stops at a halt or an error as its jq package's Evaluate does,
and a github.com subdomain reads as github.com as its auth package's
NormalizeHostname has it; and python/mirage/core/github/repo.py and
typescript/packages/core/src/core/github/repo.ts read a repository argument,
[HOST/]OWNER/REPO or a git remote URL, as its repository package's Parse and
its internal/git IsURL, ParseURL and RepoInfoFromURL read one. go-gh carries
this notice:
